title: Grateful Dead Live at The Omni on 1973-12-12
lineage: CDR > Soundforge 8 for many adjustments > Flac

ai_review.summary: Remastered soundboard delivers crystal‑clear audio of a stellar 1973 performance highlighted by a soaring Eyes > Morning Dew and classic Peggy‑O.
ai_review.review: The remastered SBD source provides an excellent, spacious mix where each instrument is distinct, despite a minor drop‑out on Phil’s bass that may be headphone‑related. Musically the show shines with standout moments such as the Eyes > Morning Dew suite, a classic Peggy‑O, and energetic renditions of Jack Straw, China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, Big River and Deal. Even though Sugar Magnolia and Casey Jones are missing, reviewers agree the remaining material more than makes up for it.

ai_rating.rationale: All seven reviews are highly positive (4‑5 stars) and consistently praise both the superb remastered soundboard quality and the exceptional musical performance, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio is described as crystal‑clear with every instrument prominent; spacious mix that lets each part breathe. One comment notes Phil’s bass drops in and out, likely a headphone issue rather than a recording flaw.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows smoothly from the opening sound check through tight transitions; despite missing Sugar Magnolia and Casey Jones, reviewers feel the core of the show – especially the second‑half jam highlights – sustains high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry is described as being at his peak with superb lead guitar tone and phrasing.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass work is praised for its power (noting a brief drop‑out that may be headphone related) and he ‘owns it’ alongside the drums.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir provides solid rhythm and vocal support, complementing Jerry beautifully.
